entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I'm calling about an order I placed a couple of months ago. I'd like to start a return for some cycling shoes.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have the order number, please?

Thank you. I see the order for the Velo-Clinch cycling shoes, delivered 71 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a fit issue. I've tried everything—adjusting the cleats, different socks, you name it—but they consistently give me terrible blisters on my heels after about ten miles. I just can't use them.

I'm very sorry to hear that; getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I've checked your purchase date, and you are well within our 90-day return window for standard items.
Oh, great. So I can get a full refund?

Absolutely. I have just authorized the return in our system. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just package the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once we receive them, a full refund will be processed back to your original payment method.

That's good news, thank you. Now, I appreciate you processing the refund, but given the trouble and the fact I couldn't ride properly for a few weeks because of the blisters, would it be possible to add a 15% discount code to my account for a future purchase?
I understand your request, but our policy allows for a full refund in this situation, which is the most we can offer for a return. We don't provide additional discounts for fit-related returns.
Okay, I see. Not even a 10%? I'm still planning to buy a different pair from you, so it seems like a win-win.

I do apologize, but providing the full refund for the item is the complete resolution we can provide. The good news is you'll have that money back to put toward a new pair that hopefully works much better for you.
Fair enough, I had to ask. The full refund is what's most important. I'll get these shipped out tomorrow. Thanks for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
